title: Higgsfield raises $400M Series B, quadrupling its valuation in 8 months to $5.4B
summary: Mashrabov told TechCrunch that Higgsfield expects “enterprise adoption of video AI to become much more deeply embedded in everyday marketing and creative workflows.” The fresh capital will fund the usual business needs like hiring and product development.
